## Goal
Make local Codex session start, compact, and wrap flows use Open Brain as a first-class memory substrate instead of relying on manual raw memory calls.

## Scope
- Define the Codex adapter behavior for session_start, compact, wrap, recall, and receipt capture.
- Integrate with current hook/session-save policy without storing raw transcripts or secrets.
- Preserve policy-refresh, dirty-state, and source-of-truth rules.
- Record useful distilled events and share_candidate nominations only when appropriate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Codex lifecycle flow is documented and implemented or stubbed behind a clear adapter boundary.
- Compaction writes include lane key, current context, dirty state, decisions, next steps, and receipt pointers.
- Tests or smoke scripts prove hook JSON validity and safe no-secret behavior.

## Timeline
Target date: 2026-06-27.

Parent plan: docs/agent-memory-substrate-plan.md
